title: Unique Preserve
statement: Implement `solve(items)`. Return the strings with duplicates removed, keeping the first-seen order. Do not sort. Comparison is exact. Case differences are different strings.
hints: A set records seen strings. A list records order.
Append only when the string is not in the set.
Add it to the set at the same time.
editorial: set(items) drops order. The order-preserving recipe is a seen set plus an output list. Sorting would make a different function. Case is significant because this problem does not say to normalize.
